For a Department of Defense proposed contract over $20 million, but not exceeding $150 million, the justification for other than full and open competition shall be approved in writing by the head of the procuring activity, or a designee who—
- If a member of the armed forces, is a general or flag officer; or
- If a civilian, is serving in a position in a grade above GS-15 under the General Schedule (or in a comparable or higher position under another schedule). [R1]
